species.name: Striped bass
why: Water 63°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 6–24 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 35 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 50 ft, so fish stay above it.
Northwest wind at 10 mph pushes bait onto the southeast shore: try the wind-blown banks.
